title: Cell Specification
description: Shared cell-spec specification for BattINFO and BDF metadata: a required identity core (id, name, model, manufacturer, cell_format, chemistry) and optional deep extensions (construction, electrodes, electrolyte, separator, housing, properties). Mirrors the cell_spec object of cell-spec.schema.json; the component holders are reused by cell-spec.schema.json.

id.description: Canonical BattINFO IRI of the cell spec (spec/ namespace).

name.description: Human-readable display name, typically manufacturer plus model.

format.description: Legacy key of the internal descriptor shape, equivalent to cell_format. New records should use cell_format.

chemistry.description: Overall cell chemistry label (e.g. 'Li-ion', 'NiMH', 'Zn-MnO2'). Use the recognised labels where they apply (see the property keys reference); other values are carried as literals.

positive_electrode_basis.description: Positive-electrode active material basis (e.g. 'LFP', 'NMC811'). Use the recognised labels where they apply (see the property keys reference); other values are carried as literals.

negative_electrode_basis.description: Negative-electrode active material basis (e.g. 'graphite', 'LTO', 'Si-C'). Use the recognised labels where they apply (see the property keys reference); other values are carried as literals.

product_type.description: Whether this cell spec is a commercial product, a research cell, or a prototype.

construction.description: Internal construction: assembly type, layering, sheet counts, and electrode-assembly geometry.

property.description: Named quantity map of cell-level properties.

positive_electrode.description: Inline description of the positive electrode (coating, current collector, tab, properties).

negative_electrode.description: Inline description of the negative electrode (coating, current collector, tab, properties).

electrolyte.description: Inline electrolyte description (family, salt, solvents, additives).

name.description: Common material or product name, e.g. 'Celgard 2400', 'glass fibre', 'ceramic-coated PP'.

material.description: Base material family, e.g. 'polyethylene', 'polypropylene', 'polyethylene-polypropylene', 'glass fibre', 'ceramic'. Use the recognised labels where they apply (see the property keys reference); other values are carried as literals.

material_spec_id.description: IRI of the material-spec this separator base material realizes.

structure.description: Physical layer structure of the separator membrane.

coating.description: Surface coating applied to the base membrane, e.g. 'Al2O3', 'SiO2', 'PVDF', 'ceramic'.

supplier.description: Supplier or vendor the item was sourced from.

property.description: Named quantity map of separator properties (e.g. thickness, porosity, gurley_number, ionic_conductivity). See the property keys reference for the full list of recognised keys.

separator.description: Inline separator description (material, structure, coating, and properties); use separator_spec_id instead to reference a standalone separator-spec.

housing.description: Inline housing description (case, cap, terminals, seals, parts); use housing_spec_id instead to reference a standalone housing-spec.
